epLog.choice: Tell him. All of it. The light, the bus, the cold, the kid. Carmen. Everything.
"This isn't a comic, man. A woman's in the hospital because I wasn't fast enough." (But let him in.)
Let her drive. She clearly knows this. Ask good questions.
"You're not crazy. I don't know what it is. But I can see you fine. Here, give me your number."
"Thank you. Seriously." Tell her the truth, or some of it: you were in the zone, it was cold, it's been weird since.
Sleep. Actually sleep. Phone across the room.
Call Ma back. It's been three days. She's called eleven times.
"Ma, everybody in Philly has my walk. It's a Philly walk." Make her laugh.
Temple University Hospital. Sixth floor. Carmen Torres. You owe her this.
"I'm sorry. I should've been faster. I should have gotten you too."
Vinnie's been blowing up your phone since the Wawa video. FaceTime him.
"What young guy? Vin. Who was Pop with?"
Slip.
The mask. Pull it off the one touching the truck. See his face.
"There's a man dying in that windshield. Let me get him out, and you walk."
"I was there. I deliver up and down Broad, Mike, I was *there*. I saw it. That's all." Not a lie. Not the truth.
Lie. "Long shift. Bad tips. I'm fine." Smile. Hands still.
Lock in. Do the practice quiz like it's the real one.
Do Ciro explaining the squeeze theorem. Get the laugh. You need it.
Take the quiz. Her handwriting is in your head.

recap.t: You moved into Cardone Hall, 9th floor. You carried a minifridge nobody asked you to carry.
At 11:51:04 on Saturday night, every clock in North Philadelphia stopped. You didn't.
You pulled a little boy named Jayden out from in front of the 16 bus. He called you "the cold man."
A nine-second video went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.
A man across Broad Street put a finger to his lips. Then a bus passed, and he was gone.

recap.t: You moved into Cardone Hall, 9th floor. You carried a minifridge nobody asked you to carry.
At 11:51:04 on Saturday night, every clock in North Philadelphia stopped. You didn't.
You pulled a little boy named Jayden out from in front of the 16 bus. He called you "the cold man."
A nine-second video went viral. The internet calls you WAWA GUY.
A man across Broad Street put a finger to his lips. Then a bus passed, and he was gone.
You told Nik everything. He wants to be your guy in the chair.
You finally went to see Carmen Torres. She gave you a medal of Saint Jude, patron of lost causes.
Three people in Gritty masks robbed an armored truck at Broad & Girard. One of them could stop things just by touching them.
The Inquirer has a new name for you: the Broad Street Blur.
Since Saturday, nobody can see Femi Ojo. Except you.
